chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from 'Abdullah ibn 'Amir from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar from al-Husayn ibn Rashid from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqtin, he raised it to them, saying:

The man says when he finishes the Adhan and sits: 'O God, make my heart pure and my sustenance abundant, and make for me a resting place and abode near the grave of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family).'
ai.seo_question: What should one say after finishing the Adhan?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith highlights the spiritual etiquette of the Mu'adhdhin, linking the public call to prayer with personal supplication for inner purity (*barra*) and divine sustenance. It specifically emphasizes the Mu'adhdhin’s desire for a permanent resting place near the Prophet’s grave, reflecting the Shia reverence for the Ahl al-Bayt and the intercessory status of the Prophet in the afterlife.
